Name: IdaIda's Furniture Recolor (for CP)
Author: idaida
Description:
[center][color=#8e7cc3][url=https://www.patreon.com/idaida][img]https://i.imgur.com/A5ZwJYT.png[/img][/url]
This mod replaces the vanilla furniture with the new and edited sprites. The colors should work well with vanilla and world recolors. 
The furniture is less saturated and the colors are more cohesive. There are full sets of light and dark wood, birch, white, and grey.
The decorative elements are moons and suns, a lot of plants, including more trendy houseplants, there's also a lot of crystal themed items.
There are some recolors that allow you to make a bathroom- you can take a 'bath' in a retextured bed, sit on a chair toilet and add a sink and shower :)

All the sprites in this mod are drawn by me or repurposed vanilla sprites that are recolored by me.


This mod makes decorating really easy and fun, so I hope you'll like it! [/color]
